title: Forensic logging and operational instrumentation
summary: Alchemy Log is the detailed forensic evidence stream; Instrumentation Mesh dev8 is the bounded operational metrics/event plane; Socket Isolation Telemetry observes carrier I/O. None owns SIP/RTP state.
invariants: Every meaningful signalling, registration, authentication, dialog, RTP or media lifecycle transition must be observable.
Alchemy Log and Instrumentation Mesh are complementary, not alternatives.
SIP and RTP retain separate instrumentation authorities even with shared call correlation.
Instrumentation correlation must not infer causation from time, host, severity, topology or proximity.
A broken observer must be isolated from protocol/media operation.
Operational telemetry must not publish credentials, raw SIP messages, audio or RTP payload by default.
procedure: For failed REGISTER, retain enough forensic evidence to distinguish missing credentials, digest rejection and successful binding.
Only publish metrics the authoritative layer actually computes.

provenance.claim: SIP/RTP use explicit correlation without ownership or inferred causation.
